name: nabla
description: Nabla — guia do aluno da POLI/UPE: teoria, banco de questões e mapa da grade.

scripts.cabecalhos: node scripts/cabecalho.mjs --check src public scripts astro.config.mjs CHANGELOG.md THIRD-PARTY.md
scripts.test: esbuild src/ilhas/progresso.ts src/ilhas/fluxograma.ts --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=.tmp-teste --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error && node testes/progresso.test.mjs && node testes/grade.test.mjs && node testes/setas.test.mjs && node testes/ponte.test.mjs
scripts.publicar: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=nabla-poli
